//: Committed pi extension manifest — the single source of truth for third-party pi packages that `agent-cortex ext install --harness pi` provisions. Add/remove an extension by editing + committing this file (reviewed via the normal PR flow); the CLI never writes it. agent-cortex's OWN bundled extensions are deliberately NOT listed here — they ride pi package discovery (package.json `pi.extensions`).

extensions.description: Web search, URL fetching, GitHub repo access, PDF/YouTube/video analysis
Token-compressing wrappers for shell/read/grep/find/ls output (hypa_* tools)
Context-mode knowledge-base tools (ctx_*) and session hooks
